test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement-I : 2 -methylbutane on oxidation with KMnO4 gives 2 -methylbutan-2-ol.

Statement-II : n -alkanes can be easily oxidised to corresponding alcohol with KMnO4.

Choose the correct option :

options.text: Both statement I and statement II are correct
Both statement I and statement II are incorrect
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
